headlines.title: Lumentum, Astera Labs, and Corning to Demonstrate 1060 nm VCSEL-Based PCIe over Optics for AI Rack-Scale Connectivity at the 2026 OCP Global Summit
headlines.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., October 12, 2026--Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE), Astera Labs, Inc. (NASDAQ: ALAB), and Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) today announced a joint demonstration of PCIe-over-optics connectivity for AI rack-scale architectures at the 2026 OCP Global Summit in San Jose, California. The rack-level demonstration combines an Astera Labs Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch with Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL-based optical interconnect platform and Corning multimode fiber connectivity.

headlines.title: Lumentum Can’t Keep Up With AI Demand—and Its Stock Is Surging
headlines.summary: Lumentum says demand for some optical components will exceed supply through 2028, lifting its shares and other optical networking stocks.

headlines.title: 3 AI Optics Stocks Worth Watching As Data Center Bandwidth Tightens
headlines.summary: AI data centers are swallowing optical bandwidth faster than suppliers can keep up, and Lumentum’s order book running tight into 2028 to 2029 is the clearest signal yet. That kind of demand crunch can reshape pricing, margins, and capital spending right across the supply chain, which is exactly where investor opportunity and risk start to widen. This article breaks down three stocks linked to that story, and how this AI optics squeeze might matter for your portfolio.

headlines.title: Nvidia-Backed Lumentum Says It Can’t Keep Up With AI Demand. The Stock Is Surging
headlines.summary: Lumentum shares are rallying Friday after the company said it’s selling out of AI server products.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
